description: Articles of Incorporation for a profit corporation, as filed with a state Secretary of State, with any filing stamp and certificate of incorporation.

filing.description: The filing office's record of the filing.

filing_office.description: The state office that received the filing, e.g. 'Wyoming Secretary of State'.

state_of_incorporation.description: The state under whose law the corporation is formed.

entity_type.description: The kind of entity being formed, as titled on the form, e.g. 'Profit Corporation'.

filing_id.description: The identification or filing number the office assigned, e.g. the 'Original ID' in the office-use box, exactly as printed.

filed_timestamp.description: The date and time stamped as filed in the office-use box, exactly as printed.

corporation_name.description: The name of the corporation as stated in the articles.

registered_agent.description: The registered agent named in the articles.

name.description: The registered agent's name, a person or a firm.

address.description: The registered agent's physical address, on one line.

mailing_address.description: The corporation's mailing address, on one line.

principal_office_address.description: The corporation's principal office address, on one line.

authorized_shares.description: Each class of shares the corporation is authorized to issue.

share_class.description: The class of shares, e.g. 'Common' or 'Preferred'.

number_of_shares.description: The number of shares authorized in this class, exactly as printed, including words such as 'Unlimited'.

par_value.description: The par value per share of this class, exactly as printed, e.g. '$0.0001'.

incorporators.description: Each incorporator named in the articles.

address.description: The incorporator's address, on one line.

signatory.description: The person who signed the articles on the filer's behalf.

name.description: The printed name of the signer.

signature_date.description: The date beside the signature, exactly as printed.

registered_agent_consent_given.description: True if the filing states that the registered agent consented to the appointment.

certificate_of_incorporation.description: The Secretary of State's certificate of incorporation, if attached.

issuing_official.description: The name of the official who certifies the incorporation.

issue_date.description: The date the certificate was executed, exactly as printed.

great_seal_affixed.description: True if the certificate states that the state's seal is affixed.
